content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: Hosted API p99/p95 latency spike and backlog growth (GPU capacity exhaustion). Paging oncall.

sre-jordan: seeing queue length climb on hosted-api -> gpu-runner pool, p95 from 220ms -> 2.4s, p99 > 7s, timeouts increasing.

oncall-alex: I'm on it. grabbing metrics dashboards and nodes. what's the current active GPU pool size?

sre-jordan: active GPUs: 18 in us-west-2 pool (shard-a). Autoscaler attempted +6 but new nodes stuck in PROVISIONING for >6m. provisioner logs show rate-limit 429 from cloud provider.

infra-maya: confirmed provider returning quota_rate_limit on instance create. we hit soft quota for that instance type in the region. open ticket to provider but ETA unknown.

eng-chi: autoscaler logs show leader enters backoff after 3 failed attempts; it stopped creating more requests, assumes transient failure. leader health is OK but create requests saturate quota.

oncall-alex: ok plan: 1) enable fallback routing to smaller models for low-priority traffic, 2) apply temporary global rate limit to reduce tail latency, 3) attempt manual scaledown of some noncritical dedicated pools and reassign GPUs.

pm-ash: we need customer impact estimate to post to status page. can support/sre give numbers for affected requests per minute and % of customers?

support-linda: initial triage: ~12 high-volume tenants reported >30% error rate in last 15m. Many are background batch jobs hitting embeddings/generation endpoints. I'll DM affected contacts and draft status.

ops-bot: Action: route-change requested by oncall-alex -> enabling fallback policy 'serve-small-model' on route /v1/generate (applied to 20% of traffic)

sre-jordan: applying routing. also toggling prefix-KV caching aggressively for conversational workloads to short-circuit token regen.

eng-chi: pushed canary fallback. early telemetry: p95 dropped from 2.4s -> 1.1s for served traffic but backlog still ~45k reqs in host queue. throughput steady but provisioning blocked.

oncall-alex: start temporary token-bucket global throttle for anonymous API keys: 20 rps per key, 50% of normal. notify partners. This should slow new incoming work.

infra-maya: manual workaround: recycled a low-priority dedicated cluster and moved two A100s back into hosted pool. That freed 2 GPUs. Effect on queue negligible right now.

pm-ash: status page draft: "We are experiencing degraded performance for hosted inference in us-west-2 due to constrained GPU provisioning. We have mitigations in place including fallback routing, customer rate-limits, and reallocating capacity. Some requests may see increased latency or errors. Engineers are investigating." Approve?

sre-jordan: send it. include ETA: investigating with provider; next update in 30m or on milestone.

support-linda: posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents/6887654321 and notified top 12 tenants. reactions: :thumbsup: :pray:

eng-chi: autoscaler leader log excerpt: ```ERROR: provisioner.create_instance failed: 429 QuotaExceeded region us-west-2 type a100. retries exhausted -> entering backoff window 300s```

oncall-alex: can we spin up smaller instance types (e.g., 8xA10 equivalents) in another AZ and register them with the pool? Cross-AZ capacity might be available.

infra-maya: good idea. spinning up mixed-instance fallback in us-west-2b and us-west-2c (cheaper instance families). will need to adjust kernel flags for quantization path. ETA ~8-10m.

eng-chi: note: model weights were compiled for AMP kernels on A100. need to ensure fallbacks use int8 kernels; will patch runtime config to allow quantized model variant automatically. Doing it now.

ops-bot: Provision attempt started -> us-west-2b: 4 instances requested.

sre-jordan: while that comes up, reduce soft timeouts from 10s -> 6s to free blocked workers quicker. Also enable aggressive prefix eviction for long-running KV caches.

oncall-alex: I want a short-term customer-facing mitigation: lower default max tokens for generation to 256 and set retry-after header. Support, please update docs and post.

support-linda: updated docs and sent email templates to customer success.

eng-chi: new mixed instances registered! +6 GPUs added (smaller type). initial perf: p95 now ~900ms, p99 ~2.8s on fallback shards. queue length trending down from 45k -> 12k over 12 minutes.

pm-ash: excellent. let's prepare post-incident action items: quota increase request with provider, autoscaler resilience to 429s (exponential vs fixed backoff), queue prioritization (tiered-rate/priority), and playbook to spin mixed-instance pools.

infra-maya: filed provider support ticket #PRV-2248 requesting quota bump. also created an internal runbook step to attempt cross-AZ provisioning before backoff engages.

sre-jordan: creating incident doc and timeline. assigning followups: autoscaler fix -> eng-chi, quota escalation -> infra-maya, customer comms wrapup -> pm-ash/support-linda.

oncall-alex: handing off to evening oncall @sre-jordan for monitoring and validation. I'll remain reachable for escalations.

sre-jordan: accepting handoff. next update planned in 30m or when backlog < 2k.

ops-bot: Incident severity set to SEV-2.

support-linda: final note: some tenants reported partial retries from client libs; recommend adding guidance to backoff/retry with jitter in SDKs.

eng-chi: saving logs and snapshotting metrics. creating postmortem draft link: https://redwood.internal/pm/incidents/6887654321 (will update with root cause and RCA).

pm-ash: thanks team — good coordination. keep thread for timeline and all remediation artifacts.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: backlog drained to <1k, p99 returned to normal baseline. Please ensure action items are tracked. Incident closed at 6887654920.
